import type { ProjectBoardColumnData, ProjectBoardTask } from "../project-board/project-board";
export const DEFAULT_PROJECT_PEOPLE = [
  { name: "Alex Reed", initials: "AR" },
  { name: "Jordan Lee", initials: "JL" },
  { name: "Sam Parker", initials: "SP" },
  { name: "Avery Quinn", initials: "AQ" },
  { name: "Robin Chen", initials: "RC" },
];
const task = (
  id: string,
  group: string,
  title: string,
  priority: ProjectBoardTask["priority"],
  project: string,
  day: number,
  done = false,
): ProjectBoardTask => ({
  id,
  group,
  title,
  priority,
  project,
  date: `${done ? "Completed" : "Since"} ${day} Sep`,
  assignees: DEFAULT_PROJECT_PEOPLE.slice(day % 2, (day % 2) + 2),
  creator: DEFAULT_PROJECT_PEOPLE[0],
  description:
    id === "DS-38"
      ? "Design the approve, request changes, and declined states. The card should remain readable in a busy conversation and make the next step obvious without interrupting the flow."
      : "Explore a clear, readable solution and make the next step easy to understand.",
  resources: [{ label: "Design file" }],
  comments: [
    {
      id: `${id}-1`,
      author: DEFAULT_PROJECT_PEOPLE[1]!,
      when: "2 hours ago",
      body: "I’ve added this to our next review. Let me know if anything is blocking progress.",
    },
    {
      id: `${id}-2`,
      author: DEFAULT_PROJECT_PEOPLE[2]!,
      when: "5 hours ago",
      body: "The initial direction is a compact summary with an expandable action preview. Let’s validate the language before refining the visual states.",
    },
  ],
});
